notes.title: v2.1 fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you would have unlocked an agent's Special Missions even if you hadn't beaten their standard mission
[*] Fixed a bug where choosing to Upgrade Start Dice wouldn't update your stats if you went straight into a battle
[*] Fixed a bug where choosing a Dice as your starting bonus wouldn't show the HUD after leaving the inventory
[*] Fixed a bug where choosing a Module as your starting bonus would show the HUD before drafting dice or a Boonus after leaving the inventory
[*] Fixed The Polter Game event still giving you a dice if you fail the event

[list]
[*] Fixed a missing tile in the training area

[/list]

notes.title: Cassie's Betrayal is now live!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Agents,

We've received word that Agent Cassie has also been spotted at the Booville Hotel. Despite rarely being seen since her disappearance 4 months ago, it seems she has definitely sided with the ghosts. If you spot her, do your best to capture her, but the Polter Prince is still the number 1 target.

Signed Captain Fuzz[/h3]

Want to check out the nitty gritty of the patch and see the detailed notes? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1422190/view/3058500029567350303]Click here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/8543cdd5fe18f6e7c6674470395d239c30756d05.jpg[/img]

This update to the game features an additional antagonist; [b]Cassie the Cat[/b]. She can appear as a boss in the Forest, Halls and Attic causing trouble each step of your mission. But maybe something will happen if you defeat her on the roof?

Cassie isn't the only new enemy to be added to the roster, every area has an additional 3 enemies, 2 minibosses and 2 bosses to expand on the variety.
But with so many enemies it'd be great to have somewhere to store the information you learn about them right? The [b]Boo~stiary[/b] is just that. Accessible on both the board and in battle, capturing enemies will unlock their dice, skills and enemy effects to study at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/aba63763073dfccb0a8831f49befbea244f9b306.jpg[/img]

The progression in the game has been altered, both [b]Weapon Unlocks[/b] and how you complete [b]Special Missions[/b].
[b]Weapons[/b] are now unlocked through the total Ghost Jars a character collects during their mission. (Cumulative Ghost Jars, not the amount you finished with. Don't be shy spending them). Win or lose, your Ghost Jars will be added to this total however there are bonuses for winning missions so do your best!

The [b]Special Missions[/b] have been turned into individual levels instead of optional modifiers. Completing these for the first time has the primary reward of a bunch of Ghost Jars to go towards unlocking weapons. The secondary reward is to unlock new [b]diary entries[/b] about the Agent's pasts, which are accessed through the [b]Boo~stiary[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/252586745f25f74cdf89a4d7bb12553c81c54d21.jpg[/img]

In regards to game features, the board will flip over its tiles as you progress, immediately showing what is on the tiles you can move to. Use this to see what ghosts are ready to battle you and change your Dice and Modules accordingly or use it to completely avoid a ghost that will give you a hard time. Buuut you'd miss out on that sweet All Battles Clear checkmark.

Speaking of the checkmark, I bet there's something that will happen if you finish a mission with [b]4 or fewer Potions used[/b], [b]All Battles Cleared[/b] and [b]within 55 minutes[/b]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/34cadf89117863475731a4668d9653d62983581f.jpg[/img]

With all these new enemies I bet you're wondering how you could possibly defeat them without new equipment. Well, Dice can now appear with almost any combination of [b]Dice Effects[/b] on them. This should expand your build's coverage and open up more options for mixed sets.

And I should mention that [b]Burn and Static[/b] have been changed up. Now they do 1 damage for every 4 stacks of Burn or Static or the enemy. Therefore building them up like Poison is much more worthwhile.
And it wouldn't be a big update without new Modules to find and balance changes to existing Modules, Ghosts and the Agents themselves.

One last thing for all you ghostly groovers out there, the soundtrack has 4 new tracks in it! Keep an ear out for these when you jump into battles.

[h3]Now roll out and get dicey![/h3]


Get the game today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1422190/Fuzz_Force_Spook_Squad/

notes.title: Cassie's Betrayal 2.0 patch notes
notes.content:
Cassie's Betrayal is a free DLC update for the game. To see a broad overview of the new features [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1422190/view/3058500029574477313]Click here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/59d7bc15c3f5d215a8e0d442520edb811ce30a83.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]3 new regular enemies, 2 new minibosses[/b] and [b]2 new bosses[/b] plus [b]Cassie the Cat[/b] in each area. Missions will have far more enemy variety than before.
[*] A [b]Boo~stiary[/b] of all enemies has been added. Capturing more and more of each ghost will show their Dice, Skills and Enemy Effects. This information can be accessed on the board or directly in battles. Now you're equipped with both knowledge and Dice!
[*] Completing [b]Special Missions[/b] unlocks diary entries from the Spook Squad about their previous adventures. These are accessed from the Boo~stiary.
[*] All tiles adjacent to your current tile will be flipped over before clicking on them. With the surrounding ghosts visible, it's possible to make more informed choices on fighting or avoiding them
[*] Begin every run by choosing a helpful bonus at the start of the Forest
[*] Some ? tiles on the board will hide an [b]extra Bonus Roll[/b] which can award (or remove) some HP or Ghost Jars. This Bonus Roll is free, will you roll for it?
[*] Dice can now be found with almost any combination of Dice Effects
[*] Composer Haakon Davidsen has made [b]new battle and boss themes[/b] to keep you bopping whilst you're rolling
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/f59f129dc7178e32a92b711c6d90735e74c163c8.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Winning or losing a mission takes the total Ghost Jars you collected during the mission (not the amount you finished with) and adds them together with certain thresholds unlocking new weapons for that character. Now even failed missions will contribute to new weapons.
[*] Winning a mission for the first time awards a bonus of 40 Ghost Jars. Winning in general awards 20 Ghost Jars, losing awards 10 for the attempt. The All Battles Clear, Under 55 Minutes and Fewer than 4 Potions checkmarks are worth 5 Ghost Jars each. Aim for those victories!
[*] Special Missions are converted into their own levels giving each character a more defined level structure. All 4 of these unlock for a character after clearing their Standard Mission and award 40 Ghost Jars for first time clears.
[*] The Random Loadout and Statless Special Missions have been removed.
[*] Previous save data will convert your previous wins and defeats into this new Ghost Jar system, unlocking some weapons instantly but some may have to be re-earned.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/8efb557ae412fc8d79c0102c30d8985c40bfe845.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Finn's Charge Blaster also inflicts 1 Burn, Poison and Static when Charged!
[*] Finn's Overloader Battery gain required reduced from 15 to 10
[*] Finn's Overloader special dice are more powerful
[*] Finn's Power Shotgun special "Biggest Shot" now only gives Attack Dice. The dice have been weakened slightly
[*] Dotty's starting battery increased from 18 to 20
[*] Dotty's Pawvise Blade now also boosts her Charge Stat after Attacking
[*] Dotty's Barkdiche now adds an extra dice instead of boosting her Attack Stat
[*] Dotty's Furchion now affects all Action Dice, not just Attack Action Dice
[*] Lix's Soul Music also gives him a Burn, Poison or Static Shield when using Shield at 0 Shield
[*] Lix's Barrier Bass now gives an Attack Dice equal to 25% of his current Shield when Attacking
[*] Lix's Barrier Bass special "Final Crescendo" now only drains half of your Shield and gives a dice for every 4 units used. The dice have been weakened to compensate
[*] Peppa's Malware.EXE special dice are more powerful
[*] Peppa's Life.EXE special dice are more powerful
[*] Peppa's Power.EXE requirement reduced from 7+ dice rolls to 6+ [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/21f3eabbb9c761e31e3b2d567fe9a79d7af68c8d.jpg[/img]
[list][*] 3rd Degree Burn changed "Your Burn damage is now 2 damage for every 4 Burn"
[*] The Burn Turn Burn inflicted increased from 1 to 2
[*] Burn Bomb damage reduced from 4 damage to 3 but is now 3 damage for every 4 Burn on the enemy. 4 with 3rd Degree Burn
[*] Static Conductor changed "Your Static damage is now 2 damage for every 4 Static"
[*] Burn/Static UP removed
[*] Quick Heal start of battle heal increased from 4HP to 5HP
[*] Sick Dodge reduced from giving 2 Dodge to 1
[*] Extra Special now doubles the value of the Extra Action when adding it to your Special guage
[*] Lucky 5 is now Lucky 4 and activates every 4 turn
[*] Recovery Station, Portable Anvil, Tray O'Ghosts and Power Boost removed
[*] Victory Potion moved to the Boss Module pool
[*] Hearty Potion increased from healing 50% of Max HP to 75% of Max HP
[*] Bottomless Potion chance increased from 40% to 50%
[*] Always Angry now gives an all 10 Charge Dice instead of automatically refilling Battery[/list]

[h3]New Modules[/h3]
[list][*] All or Nothing: Every turn all your stats are put into a single Action
[*] Action Balance: Stats +2 to the Actions not used last turn
[*] Battery Powered: Begin battles with full HP but 1 Battery
[*] Battery Booster: Roll your Charge Stat Dice when your Battery is 6 or fewer
[*] Close Enough: Win battles if the enemy has 1,2 or 3HP at the end of your turn
[*] Special Agent: Gain 5 Special each turn
[*] Lunar Panels: Start every battle with full battery
[*] Attack Focused: Attack Stat +5, Shield and Charge Stats-2
[*] Shield Focused: Shield Stat +5, Attack and Charge Stats-2
[*] Charge Focused: Charge Stat +5, Shield and Charge Stats-2
[*] Health Focused: Max HP +15, Max Battery -7
[*] Battery Focused: Max Battery +20, Max HP -7
[*] Shield Master: Max HP set to 10. Roll an all 10 Shield Dice every turn
[*] Battery Master: Max Battery set to 10. Roll an all 10 Charge Dice[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/f982079514813f03bfd891ae4a4e563854725cc7.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Changed the mission results potion limit from 3 or fewer to 4 or fewer
[*] Changed the mission results time limit from Under 45 Minutes to Under 55 Minutes
[*] Changed the HP increase of a Stat point at the end of each area from +1 Max HP to +2 Max HP
[*] Changed the stat point requirement from capturing all the ghosts to capturing the 4 regular ghosts
[*] Renamed the Area Cleared bonus to All Ghosts Captured for clarity
[*] There's now a whole bunch of new dice to enable a high value playstyle!
[*] Dice can now spawn with almost any combination of effects but there's still a chance they'll match
[*] Added the third dice effect symbol to the break room and game over screens for this change
[*] Increased the chance a Dice's Effects will match the effect of your Modules from 15% to 25%
[*] Potion healing increased from 33% to 40% of Max HP
[*] Renamed Area Cleared (the bonus and on the Area Complete screen) to All Ghosts Captured for clarity
[*] The name of the mission will now show on the Mission Success/Failure screen on the left
[*] Drafty Dungeons now gives 3 Ghost Jars for winning battles due to lack of chests and battle rewards
[*] Boonus Floors now lets you choose 1 of 2 challenge modifiers, or a random one, each area instead of being randomly assigned one
[*] The Boonus Floors panel will show on the Mission Success/Failure screen to show the Boonuses you finished with
[/list]
[h3]Boonus Floors changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jacko increased from 3 Burn on battle start to 5
[*] Tenrec changed to give 5 Static Shield on battle start, not 2 Static Shield every turn
[*] Jackobox changed to give 5 Burn Shield on battle start, not 2 Burn Shield every turn

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/bf987d63c43a327b592071c986d390bd5d4fafc8.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Hovering the Burn, Static and Poison icons below the HP bar shows how much damage will be taken. This will reflect modules that power up Burn and Static damage too
[*] Burn now increases its damage by 1 every 4 stacks the character has
[*] Static now increases its damage by 1 every 4 stacks the character has

[*] Enemies that use Drain skills now take damage if they have Static on them
[*] Poison dice apply less Poison. 2/3/4 reduced to 1/2/3
[*] Angry dice apply less Angry. 2/3/4 reduced to 1/2/3
[*] If you're Status Immune the Mimic's taunts won't lower your battery
[*] If you're Status Immune you won't get effects from attacking Burn, Poison or Static Shields

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/c35d0029cbd0934cd9a341f1c6db3fde1b96c7ef.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Caterpillar HP reduced from 17 to 15

notes.title: Fuzz Force joins the Tiny Teams festival!
notes.content:
The [b]Tiny Teams festival[/b] is an event run by the [b]Yogscast[/b] to celebrate game development teams of 5 or less members. The event runs from the 7th to the 14th of August and you'll be able to browse a whole bunch of games by tiny teams.

I've been working on the game by myself so I certainly qualify!
My name is Alan and I worked on the game for 18 months as I learned how to code a game. I have a background in game art, so learning everything else has been a fun process.

The game is going to be livestreamed by the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast]Yogscast twitch channel[/url] on Monday during the 5-9pm BST block called Roundguard Roguelike. Its a perfect time to check out the game if you want to see it in action.

If you want to feel it in action, there's a free demo you can download. Take on the mission to defeat the ghost bear as either Finn, Dotty or Lix. Do you have the dice rolling skill to succeed?

During this event the game will be running a 15% discount, which makes it a great time to pick it up.

[h2]But what is the game?[/h2]
Fuzz Force: Spook Squad is a dice based roguelite inspired by Dicey Dungeons and Slay the Spire. Find and equip dice to roll in battles versus a range of ghostly foes. Pick your path across the board game world for treasure, shops and hopefully the exit on your mission to capture the Polter Prince.

Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/RAtpCwqcam]Fuzz Force HQ Discord[/url] and share your best runs and experiences with the game! 
Have fun in the world of Fuzz Force.

notes.title: The tutorial is improved!
notes.content:
It's become clear during Launch Week that the tutorial has fallen by the wayside and certain mechanics aren't too easy to understand. I've been through the tutorial to improve how the information is conveyed, especially in regards to the Stat Dice.

[list]
[*] Updated the Tutorial so the events and in-battle text books are clearer
[*] You start the Tutorial with 20 ghost jars so you can use the shop and blacksmith fully
[*] There's an added explanation on equipping Dice and how the Action/Stat Dice affect the Dice
[*] All instances of Attack+x, Shield+x, Charge+x have been renamed to Attack Stat:X for clarity
[*] Rewrote the descriptions of TriStatus and TriAction dice Modules since only I know what a Tristatus and Triaction are
[*] Anti-Poison reduced to 1hp heal instead of the total poison stacks. You're still Poison immune so it now blocks the Poison Gas from Chests
[*] Removed the Modules related to the Power dice effect, they seem difficult to understand
[*] The Battery bar will now flash when you're at 6 or below Battery during battle.
[*] The Battery Empty symbol now says "Battery Empty" instead of having an X

[*] Fixed the Battery Empty symbol not appearing when your Action Dice roll was the same as your remaining Battery
[*] Fixed a bug between the MirrorCat and the Sick Dodge module
[*] Fixed a bug in the shops where the status effect book page overlapped the dice/module pages
[*] Fixed a bug with the inventory showing the wrong stats when buying from a shop
[*] Fixed current HP exceeding MaxHP when going to a new floor Max HP increased by Modules and Stat Points
[*] Added additional text to the victory choice screen to make it clear you already get a Ghost Jar for winning
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life update!
notes.content:
After seeing people play the game on launch day there's been some feedback about helpful features, some bugs were discovered and some changes related to the economy. I hope these improve your ghost hunting experience!

[list]
[*] - The Enemy battle effects will now pop out of the right side of the screen when they activate, much like your Modules
[*] - The Inventory will now properly show the correct numbers on the Stat dice and the "Stat + X" text
[*] - The dice in the inventory will now update when you equip a module which increases a Stat
[*] - Changed the Dice Effects button in the inventory from ? to a mix of Status Symbols
[*] - Upgraded dice now show in the blacksmith with their symbols
[*] - The Bonus Rolls 'Upgrading Rare/Uncommon dice is expensive' now sets the price of the dice to x3 it's cost instead of 99 and is affected by the Discount Card Module and the Bonus Roll that affects the price
[*] - The cost to upgrade Dice has increased slightly
[*] - The cost to purchase Dice and Modules now increase by floor. +1 Halls, +2 in the Attic. This doesn't affect the Dice's upgrade cost
[*] - The cost to purchase a Potion now increases by +1 and +2, instead of +2 and +4 in the Halls and Attic
[*] - Shop Dice will now be more likely to be uncommon and rare as you progress instead of the same rarity chances each floor
[*] - Equipping the Discount Card Module whilst in the shop will now update the prices in the shop
[*] - One Mimic face has been removed from the Chest Bonus Rolls and been replaced with a Broken Dice which means you get no dice
[*] - Mimics once again give Modules for beating them
[*] - Danger is no longer blocked by Status Immune since it's a buff like Dodge
[*] - The Sick Counter Module now applies if the enemy hits your Shield

[*] - Fixed a bug where buying the right Dice in the shop would deduct the price of the middle Dice from your total
[/list]

notes.title: Spook Squad launches to v1.0 Release!
notes.content:
Welcome Agents, to the world of [b]Fuzz Force: Spook Squad[/b]! I'm super excited to be launching my first game and I hope you enjoy it. Thanks to everyone who helped with bugs and balancing during Early Access, I couldn't have done it by myself.

[previewyoutube=LcUQsEzc_BM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new in v1.0?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/22e59b04bb6efe4f5c96fc1240a19b3dd4bb3780.png[/img]
Fresh to the game, and finally back from his vacation, the [b]Polter Prince[/b] arrives and awaits you at the top of the Tower. He's more than ready to deliver a royal smackdown if you haven't properly prepared  on your journey to the rooftop. Along with the Polter Prince, he's brought some special events where you can encounter him before your battle. Keep your wits about you Agent, as the Prince is always playing pranks.
In addition to the Polter Prince events, each area has even more events for you to discover and overcome.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/46abb01c7ab97826167962bc071ac7d45db31445.jpg[/img]
[b]Weapons[/b] are now unlocked in tiers instead of one at a time. By capturing the Polter Prince with unique weapons, you'll unlock a weapon for each character in one go.  Each weapon offers a new Weapon Ability and Special skill that matches a character's specialities giving a new way to play your favourite Agent.
Winning a mission with a weapon will display a crown icon on the character select screen to prove you've mastered it. Can you get all 16 crowns?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/f618b9c3dcab8fbdbd7c66fea9684806a6149329.jpg[/img]
[b]Steam Achievements[/b] and [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b] have been added. There's over 25 achievements to get for completing various challenges throughout the game. There isn't a 'Catch 1000 Ghosts' achievement, don't worry. I hope you're able to get them all, the ones related to Special Missions are going to be a doozy.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38758538/88d4d1c7b12d2ee725624baaf1e7c6bfe170354f.jpg[/img]
Speaking of [b]Special Missions[/b], 3 new ones have been added to really test your skills. Special Missions are unlocked after capturing the Polter Prince with a character for the first time. They are modifiers that apply to a run and will change the way you think about how you play. The best part is you can use as many as you like, go for all 6 if you're an Elite Agent! These are the additional challenges you can undertake.
[list]
[*] [b]No Shops:[/b] Shops and blacksmiths no longer appear. No potions or upgrades for you
[*] [b]Drafty Dungeons:[/b] Each floor you're offered 3 Dice and 3 Modules. You'll pick one of each and chests won't appear.
[*] [b]Random Loadout:[/b] Each floor your Dice and Modules are totally randomised. You'll have to make the best of what you get.
[*] [b]Blindfold Mode:[/b] Every tile appears as a ? tile. Will the next tile be a shop or will it be the miniboss?
[*] [b]Statless: [/b]Your Stats start at 0 and you can't change your stat dice. No more relying on stat-combos.
[*] [b]Boonus Floors: [/b]Every non-boss floor gives you a random modifier which persists the whole mission. Will luck shine on you?
[/list]

[h2]But what is Fuzz Force: Spook Squad?[/h2]
If you're a new recruit, then Fuzz Force: Spook Squad is a deckbuilder with dice set in a board game world. You'll find and use dice, with a variety of numbers, instead of cards to battle ghosts. Defeated ghosts give you passive ability Modules which you'll equip to create a build. Your mission is to navigate the board game one tile at a time and capture the Polter Prince on the roof.
It's the perfect roguelite if you're new to the deckbuilding genre or find existing roguelites a touch difficult.
Head to the store page and check out the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1422190/Fuzz_Force_Spook_Squad/

[h2]The v1.0 Patch Notes and the FF Discord[/h2]
Feel free to join the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/RAtpCwqcam]Fuzz Force Discord[/url][/b], it's the best place to chat about strategies with other players, getting up to date news and talking with the dev (about bugs mostly!).
Want to see the specifics of the 1.0 patch? [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1422190/view/3056235532859971968]Then click here![/url][/b]

[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
Thanks to everyone who has helped me during the development of the game. 18 months ago I didn't even know how to code since I was purely an artist but with lots of help we've made a game I'm proud of. Thanks to those who joined the Discord, the newsletter, followed and gave feedback on twitter, those who have streamed or made a video about the game and thanks to everyone who played the demo and those who have this game in their wishlists.
Thanks to everyone and let's look forward to what else Fuzz Force has in store!

notes.title: The Chopped Chips update
notes.content:
The key part of this update is the change to the Dice and Battlechip system but this update also contains 3 new weapons for every character. Each changes the way the character can be played whilst maintaining their base strengths. At release, these will be unlockable based on wins. So make sure to try them out now before then. They don't have unique models yet but they will!

Since the inception of Lucky Turns, the dominant strategy is to take the dice with the most repeated numbers and aim for Lucky Turns. This meant your buffs/debuffs didn't tick down and you'd get to use your Modules a second time. Therefore loadouts were centralised around rolling 1,2,3 and 4 which isn't using the whole spectrum of numbers. Lucky Turns were so useful that even rolling 2s in the Attic wasn't much of an issue. To combat this, dice have been reworked to only have pairs of numbers on which will reduce the occurrence of Lucky Turns.

Dice in general are reworked to have higher numbers and now function on a common, uncommon and rare system. Battlechips are integrated back into the Dice like before and function on the same system. Rolling rarer Statuses will increase the duration or potency of the effect. You can also attach a status to your stat dice for deeper customisation.

Whilst low numbers meant more Lucky, there wasn't the capcity for higher numbers as they drained more of your battery. Now, when a boss is defeated you can forego upgrading your Attack, Shield or Charge to increase your HP and Battery instead.
Let me know what you think of this massive change on Discord, Steam Hub or twitter.
___
Changelog
-12 new weapons have been added for the characters to play with
-Dice have been re balanced to only have pairs of numbers on them reducing Lucky Turns
-Player dice have all been buffed from totaling 13 to 20
-Dice now work off a common/uncommon/rare system instead of Forest/Halls/Attic
-Chips are removed and dice are once again found with Status Effects already on them as shown by the symbols
-Common dice have grey symbols which is the same effect they used to have, uncommon are white and a bit stronger and rare are yellow and stronger still.
-Upgrading a common dice ups its values by 6, uncommon by 5 and rare by 4.
-Chests and Shops can now give upgraded dice.
-The shop now sells 3 dice, 2 modules and a potion
-Information regarding Dice and they're upgrade values are no much clearer
-Instead of finding chips which add 2,3 or 4 status symbols to the dice, it's always set to 3 symbols on the Action Dice.
-You can now assign a dice to your Stat Dice which will give your Stat Dice 2 status symbols. You can make your own combos!
-If your Stat is 6 or more and the status symbol is rolled, you'll get an extra effect. This includes the Charged! buff
-Putting an upgraded dice in the stat slot increases that stat by 1
-Power Dice now show their boosted numbers at all times. Putting a Power Dice in a Stat slot increases that stat by 2,3 or 4
-Instead of choosing between a stat point or 3 ghost jars after a boss, the choice is now a stat point or a 4 Max HP and Battery
-Shield now degrades by 20% of its value instead of at certain thresholds
-Enemies have been buffed to accommodate the power of your dice increasing
-Stun, Crush and Vital and their related Modules have been removed.
-Danger reworked into being a multiple turn buff like Angry which increases all your dice rolls by 2 as long as you're under half health
-Screens involving dice and modules have been updated.
-The shop and the blacksmith let you swap freely between seeing your dice and modules instead of being set to what you're looking at.
-The weapon inventory backpack now scrolls through all dice and modules in an easier to see way
-A new checkbox in the weapon inventory shows an equipped dice's full information when hovering over it.
-Winning a Module after a fight will now let you scroll across all your equipped and backpack modules
-Extra Sickness Module now works on Special skills and status duration increased to 2
-Dirty Potion, Filtered Potion and Potion Bomb have been removed.

Bugs
-Fixed burn activating on dodge
-Fixed modules being active in battle if they were in a slot that is now empty
-Fixed being able to cancel out of a roll after rolling a dice
-Fixed the player still doing angry damage against a Mirrorcat
-Fixed the percentage for dice matching your Modules to 15% from 0%
-Fixed the dodge sound effect in the forest playing at full volume
-The volume sliders now use the whole slider and affect the music properly
-Fixed Quality resetting to ultra every time the level changed
-Fixed Jackobox not spinning in its attack animation

notes.title: The Art n Polish update!
notes.content:
It's been a very busy 2 weeks. The enemies who were missing models now have them, there's a load of new animations for enemies throught the game and there's a funky new battle intro. You can cancel rolling your dice if you misclick which will surely be useful. Outside of battle checking out dice upgrades is far easier. You can see the upgrade values when you first get the dice, toggle an option in the backpack and now upgrade dice directly from your backpack! Talk about convenient. 

Speaking of the backpack, it's now saved across the Forest, Halls and Attic and only emptied when using the stairs after the boss. When you activate a Module whilst exploring the board, you'll get a popout similar to those in battle so you know it's worked. 

There's a bunch of new Modules including using your Potion in battle and the Boss Modules are replaced with new unique effects instead of just upgrades to existing ones. On top of that there's a lot of bug fixes and I've changed the checkmarks at the end of a mission to "Less than 3 Potions used", "All Battles Clear and "Under 45 Minutes" with a sight for them to be achieveable on all runs!

Have fun with this update, Agents.
___
Changelog
-Many enemies have new attack and idle animations!
-The Comboonation enemies, the Tenrec, Owl(Was Skeleton) and Mirrorcat have their new models
-You can now cancel your Attack, Shield, Charge and Special before rolling a dice by clicking mouse 2.
-New animation for entering battle!
-Movement added to the battle camera whilst choosing your action
-Successive Enemies no longer gain HP. Enemies in Area 2 have +3HP compared to their Area 1 counterparts.
-Finn Battery increased from 24 to 25
-Peppa was starting with Lix's Shield Dice, now has her own. Special now uses the Gold Extra Action symbols which do 5 of that action instead of 3.
-Catertrap Lucky: Poison removed. Scared no longer poisons. Shield dice reduced
-Bear Shield dice increased
-Spider HP reduced from 28 to 24, enrage shield lowered from 8 to 6.
-Hand's Turn Drain reduced from 3 Battery to 2.
-Skeleton is now a Screech Owl. It gains Shield when it taunts. Shield dice values increased. New Special Regen Screech adds 1 dodge, 2 regen
-Ghost has one dice face swapped from Scaredy Cat to attack
-Butler Attack dice increased a bit
-Jacko box shield dice reduced. Added third Attack dice.
-Gargobox graphic and Unlucky regen fixed. Turn:Shield reduced to 2
-Mimic HP increased. Forest: 18 to 20. Halls: 37 to 40. Attic 50 to 53
-Scared! chips have been added. Now you can cleanse your own Status Effects but have to Shield the next turn. Each Shield roll gets +1
-All Crush chips faces increased by 1. Crush1 is now Crush2 etc.
-All Dodge chips faces increased by 1. Dodge1 is now Dodge2 etc.

-You'll now only see at max 2 of the same enemy per floor
-Extra impassable tile added for more interesting layouts
-New Module popouts on the overworld when a module activates
-Dice in your paw show their upgrade values in brackets if not yet upgraded
-Upgraded dice in the backpack have a yellow background
-Backpack is now saved between floors and when Save&Quitting
-You can upgrade backpack dice in the blacksmith!
-Potion Seller event tweaked to become a dice roll
-Area Clear reward reduced to 2 Ghost Jars
-Modules and potions are more expensive in the halls+attic
-The stairs now say if youre going to Area 2 or to a Boss floor next.
-The boss floors are now 5x4 with chests either side of the boss, so you dont have to pass over the stairs multiple times.

____
Modules (Up from 66 to 77!)
-Quick Heal increased from 3HP to 4HP
-Ascending Spirits removed
-Auto Potion added. It uses your potion in battle when you hit 10 or less HP, benefits from other potion modules
-Energized Fuzz. +5 Max Battery and +1 Charge
-Scared Recovery. Heals 2HP for each Status Effect it removes
-Scared Energy. Gain 5 Battery and Charged when you become Scared!
-Scared Flailing. Scared Bonus increased by your Shield stat. Roll an Attack dice with your Attack stat on each face.
-Potion Bomb. Using a Potion in battle hurts the Enemy equal to the health it heals you.
-Dirty Potion. Using a Potion in battle inflicts 2 Burn, Static and Poison on the Enemy
-Filtered Potion. Using a Potion in battle clears your negative Status Effects.
-TriStatus Dice. Always have an all 0 dice with a TriStatus Chip (1 burn, 1 poison, 1 static face)
-TriAction Dice. Always have an all 0 dice with a TriAction Chip (1 extra Attack, 1 extra Shield, 1 extra Charge)
-Free Power. Framed dice rolls 8+ costs no Battery

New Boss Modules added to replace the existing ones (except Red Ribbon)
-Always Angry. You're angry every turn but get refill all your missing battery too
-Static Skewer. Static hits both the Enemy Shield and HP at the same time
-Burn Bomb. Causing Burn damage 4 times causes an additional 4 Burn damage
-Anti Poison. You heal off Poison damage the enemy takes and Poison damage you would take as you're now immune!
-Revive. A one use module that heals you back to Max HP and Battery when you hit 0HP.
-Lucky 5. Every 5 turns you gain a dice with your Lucky Number on all sides matching your chosen Action.
-Bottomless Potion. 40% chance of getting another Potion after using your current one
-All Rounder. +1 Attack, Shield and Charge stats
-Buff Fuzz. +10 Max HP and Battery
-Status Extender. Applied Status durations +1


___
Bugs
-Delay added when poison damage ends the battle
-The above fixes an issue with further enemies having a shield when defeated by poison
-Enemy Counter Attacks changed to be at the end of your actions and increased to 3 damage.
-Charge Attack renamed to Drain Attack
-Static description changed to mention Drain
-Buff and debuff icons have a big bounce effect when applied or changed
-Added sound to Finns new special particles
-Lowered delay on rolling a 0 on an Attack/Shield/Charge dice before moving to next Action
-Fixed dice particles remaining on screen when enemies were defeated by poison
-Fixed not taking poison damage on your first turn if a Mirrorcat reflected your Quick Poison
-Fixed Dodge Attack not benefitting from the Dodge Lightning Charged! effect
-Fixed getting overkill Battery if the enemy dodged the Attack that'd defeat them
-Fixed Potent Poison and Potent Poison+ not applying the correct amount of poison
-Fixed Charging and inflicting Static damage on yourself not ending the battle
-Fixed going into battle with Tough Fuzz or Steel Stomach healing you by their HP increases. I think this was a thing
-Taking off those Modules with less HP than they add will cause a Game Over
-Fixed characters returning to idle from their chest opening animations
-Fixed mimics counting towards Area Cleared
-Fixed a bug where potions didn't work
-Fixed the HP bar not going back to red if you healed but didn't end up at more than 25% HP
-Fixed that blank wall cutting into the side of the Attic and Forest battle arenas
-Fixed title screen music playing when mute is set
-Fixed loading a game not stopping the title music
-Fixed an issue where Save&Quit with Peppas starting dice would make you unable to load it
-Hopefully fixed a bug where battle music would overlap/not stop properly
-Fixed All Battles Clear not working with the new floor layout
-Starting Gear Only replaced with Mission clear time "Under 45 minutes"
-No potions changed to "3 or fewer Potions" to make it more achieveable for regular runs
-Can now only get the potion and mission checkmarks on successful mission
-Anti-aliasing added to break room
-Fixed a hole in Peppas body and made her neck black

notes.title: Early Access is here!
notes.content:
Fuzz Force: Spook Squad is now live on Early Access so it's time to pick up your dice-powered weapons and get to exploring the second area: The Halls.
Maybe you found the Forest a bit on the easy side but can you carry that momentum over on the next leg of your mission? 4 new enemies, a tough new boss and a slew of new events are ready for you to overcome them.

And since this is Early Access, I want to hear from you about what you think!
-You can [url=https://discord.com/invite/9Fuq93h]join the Discord[/url] from here or the Title Screen. It'd be great to build a community on there of reports and feedback
-The Bug Report in the top right takes a screenshot and can send Bugs, Suggestions and Compliments
-The Steam Community HUB is quite fresh but I'll be checking that too
-You can also message [url=https://twitter.com/FuzzForce]FuzzForce on Twitter[/url], the above are preferred but I want to hear from you any which way
Let's make this game better together!

---
There's been some changes since the Steam Demo too:
[list]
[*] Ferrlicity now appears in the areas and will upgrade your dice for a fee
[*] Beating a boss will give you the chance to upgrade your Stats or take some Ghost Jars
[*] The game can be saved between floors. This data is deleted upon reloading so good for a pause.
[*] All modules can now be obtained. There's loads!
[*] Crush, Vital and Danger Battlechips are dropped as rewards for battle
[*]__   Crush: Instantly removes an enemy's shield
[*]__   Vital: Boosts your diceroll by 1 when above 50% HP
[*]__   Danger: Boosts your diceroll by 3 when below 50%HP
[*] Stun is blocked by having a Shield
[*] Dodge avoids a single attack until attacked instead of all attacks for one turn
[*] Dice are heavier and enemy turns are quicker
[*] The shop shows your equipped dice and modules when browsing
[*] Finn down to 25HP, Dotty up to 30HP
[*] Static Miracle Module changed to Static Stun: Enemy is stunned after 6 Static hits
[*] Lots of bug fixes and general improvements
[/list]
